name: Shrinking
description: Jimmy is struggling to grieve the loss of his wife while being a dad, friend, and therapist. He decides to try a new approach with everyone in his path: unfiltered, brutal honesty. Will it make things better—or unleash uproarious chaos?

videos.title: Inside Shrinking
videos.overview: A short introduction to the series with interviews with the cast.

videos.title: Coin Flip
videos.overview: Jimmy, a therapist mourning his wife, takes a more proactive approach with his patients in the hopes that helping them will help himself.

videos.title: Fortress of Solitude
videos.overview: To get Sean out of legal trouble, Jimmy reconnects with his estranged best friend—while trying to hide it all from Paul.

videos.title: Fifteen Minutes
videos.overview: Jimmy witnesses Gaby in a compromising situation. Paul advises Alice on how to deal with her grief while facing a loss of his own.

videos.title: Potatoes
videos.overview: As things spiral at work, Jimmy confronts Liz for interfering in his life. Paul struggles with whether to tell his daughter his diagnosis.

videos.title: Woof
videos.overview: When Jimmy hits a roadblock with Sean, he doesn’t have Paul to consult for advice. Brian makes an announcement about his relationship.

videos.title: Imposter Syndrome
videos.overview: At Alice’s urging, Jimmy agrees to host a party. Gaby struggles with her post-divorce libido. Liz recommends medical marijuana to Paul.

videos.title: Apology Tour
videos.overview: Jimmy attempts damage control after his party. Paul’s daughter pays another visit. Liz and Sean discover they have something in common.

videos.title: Boop
videos.overview: Paul and Brian come to Jimmy’s aid when Alice starts acting out. Liz and Sean support Gaby by accompanying her to an event.

videos.title: Moving Forward
videos.overview: Jimmy encourages an ambivalent Paul to accept a career achievement award. Sean approaches Liz with a business proposal.

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: As Brian's wedding approaches, Alice takes issue with how Jimmy is living his life. Liz learns a secret.

videos.title: Jimmying
videos.overview: Jimmy grapples with his guilt over Grace. Paul makes a decision about his relationship. Liz tries to help Gaby find balance in her busy life.

videos.title: I Love Pain
videos.overview: Paul and Jimmy disagree about Sean's treatment plan. Gaby's sister asks for her help. Liz has an idea for boosting business at the food truck.

videos.title: Psychological Something-ism
videos.overview: Jimmy and Brian help Grace deal with unexpected news. Paul and Julie face her past. Liz worries she's come between Sean and his dad.

videos.title: Made You Look
videos.overview: Paul challenges Jimmy to show restraint with Sean. Derek introduces Gaby to a friend. Liz advises Brian about parenthood.

videos.title: Honesty Era
videos.overview: Jimmy helps Alice cope with a huge mistake. Gaby goes home for a family crisis. Liz runs into an old flame.

videos.title: In a Lonely Place
videos.overview: Paul and Jimmy look for Sean's dad. Gaby tries to keep Liz from sinking. Alice is surprised to find out who Brian has been spending time with.

videos.title: Get in the Sea
videos.overview: Jimmy spends the day with a patient. Brian crashes Gaby's date. Liz heads down a dangerous path.

videos.title: Last Drink
videos.overview: Jimmy faces Alice's secret. Liz and Derek are at a crossroads. Paul worries about his health.

videos.title: Full Grown Dude Face
videos.overview: While trying to stay out of Alice's business, Jimmy has to "Jimmy" an insecure Brian. Gaby leans on Paul for advice after her sister drops a bomb.

videos.title: Changing Patterns
videos.overview: Jimmy tries to give Alice the perfect 18th birthday. Paul helps Gaby with a huge decision.

videos.title: The Drugs Don't Work
videos.overview: Paul encourages Jimmy to seek help. Brian and Derek take Sean to look for a new place. Gaby struggles with her guest list for Thanksgiving.

videos.title: The Last Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Jimmy takes Paul's advice about Alice. Liz finally finds her purpose. Gaby hosts Thanksgiving dinner.

videos.title: My Bad
videos.overview: Jimmy grapples with being an empty nester and feeling torn about Alice's major life choice. Paul faces fresh challenges with his Parkinson's.

videos.title: Happiness Mission
videos.overview: The gang unites to support Paul during a health setback. Jimmy and Alice help Louis take a big step. Liz and Derek make a tough choice.

videos.title: D-Day
videos.overview: Jimmy and Liz show up for Brian and Charlie when Ava goes into labor. Sean reconnects with his ex Marisol.

videos.title: The Field
videos.overview: Gaby invites Jimmy to speak to her class. When Derek ends up in the hospital, Liz has issues with their son. Paul has an important realization.

videos.title: Hold Your Horsies
videos.overview: Jimmy and Meg unite over their love for Paul. Gaby considers her future with Derrick #2. Marisol pushes Sean and Alice out of their comfort zones.

videos.title: Dereks Don't Die
videos.overview: When Derek's health takes a turn for the worse, Jimmy helps Liz cope. Meg comes clean with Paul. Gaby makes progress with Maya.

videos.title: I Will Be Grape
videos.overview: Alice and Jimmy celebrate Tia's birthday. Liz's mother-in-law visits. Paul ponders his legacy.

videos.title: Depression Diet
videos.overview: Jimmy finally goes on a first date with Sofi. Gaby has a crisis of confidence. Liz learns more about Brian's living situation.

videos.title: Daddy Issues
videos.overview: Jimmy is stressed out by his father's presence. Sean grapples with the fallout of his decision. Paul helps Gaby start something new.

videos.title: The Bodyguard of Sadness
videos.overview: The gang celebrates Alice's graduation, as Jimmy struggles with unresolved feelings. Liz and Derek differ on what their future should look like.

videos.title: And That's Our Time
videos.overview: As Alice heads to college, Jimmy tries to repair things before it's too late. Gaby makes a happy discovery.

awards: Nominated for 9 Primetime Emmys. 12 wins & 62 nominations total
